apprehend.definitionKo: 수사 기관이 법을 어기거나 범죄를 저지른 사람을 잡아 가두다.
apprehend.englishDescription: For law enforcement authorities to catch and lock up a person who has broken the law or committed a crime.

apprehend.definitionKo: 법원에서 신문하기 위하여 피고인이나 증인, 사건에 관계된 사람 등을 강제로 끌고 가다.
apprehend.englishDescription: To forcefully take a person related to a case such as a defendant, witness,etc., to court for questioning.

crash.definitionKo: 어떤 물체가 다른 물체에 세차게 부딪치다.
crash.englishExpression: hit; beat; strike; bump; crash; knock
crash.englishDescription: For an object to be struck hard into another object.

crash.definitionKo: 매우 세게 마주 닿다. 또는 마주 닿게 하다.
crash.englishDescription: For something to hit hard against another thing; to make this happen.
To come face-to-face with a person or thing at such close range as to nearly run into the person or thing.

crash.definitionKo: 유리나 얼음장이 부딪치거나 갈라질 때 울리는 소리가 나다.
crash.englishDescription: For a ringing sound to be made when sheets of glass or pieces of ice clash with each other or split.
(emphasizing form) For something to hit hard against another.

den.definitionKo: 나쁜 짓을 하는 무리가 모여 있는 본거지.
den.englishDescription: The base of a group that does bad things.

derailment.definitionKo: 기차나 전차 등의 바퀴가 선로를 벗어남.
derailment.englishDescription: An act of the wheels of a train, streetcar, etc., jumping the rails.

fine.definitionKo: 규칙을 어겼을 때 벌로 내게 하는 돈.
fine.englishDescription: A monetary penalty imposed on a person who violates a rule.

fine.definitionKo: 범죄를 저지른 사람에게 처벌로 내게 하는 돈.
fine.englishDescription: A monetary penalty imposed on a person who commits a crime.
Very good or stylish.

fine.definitionKo: 개인이나 기업이 잘못된 경제 활동을 하였을 때, 부당하게 얻은 이익에 대하여 국가에서 거두어들이는 돈.
fine.englishDescription: Money collected by the government from a person or company on illegal gains from unfair economic activities.

fine.definitionKo: 해야 할 일을 하지 않거나 가벼운 질서를 위반한 사람에게 국가에서 납부하게 하는 돈.
fine.englishDescription: Money collected by the government on light violations; a fine for neglect of duties.
Powder or a granule being very tiny.

fine.definitionKo: 가벼운 범죄에 물리는 적은 액수의 벌금.
fine.englishDescription: A small amount of penalty imposed on a light crime.
Something being so small that it is difficult to discern.

fine.definitionKo: 도로 교통법의 규칙을 어긴 사람에게 내게 하는 벌금.
fine.englishDescription: Monetary penalty levied on someone who breaks the traffic law.
The powder of something being very small and soft.

fine.definitionKo: 규칙을 어겼을 때 벌로 내게 하는 돈.
fine.englishDescription: A monetary penalty  imposed on a person who violates a rule.

fine.definitionKo: 범죄를 저지른 사람에게 처벌로 내게 하는 돈.
fine.englishDescription: A monetary penalty imposed on a person who commits a crime.
The powder of something being very small and soft.

fine.definitionKo: 액수를 매겨서 세금이나 벌금 등으로 물리는 돈.
fine.englishDescription: Imposed tax or fine.
Fairly good.
Having no particular problems.

fine.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 이루려고 기회를 살피거나 다짐할 때 쓰는 말.
fine.englishDescription: An exclamation used to express that one is trying to grab an opportunity or renew his/her resolve to achieve something.
The size of grains being very small.
The weave of a fabric, net, etc., being fine.
Fine and thin.
Extremely beautiful.

fine.definitionKo: 구름이나 안개가 끼지 않아 날씨가 좋다.
fine.englishDescription: (for the weather) Fine without clouds or mist.
Very good.
All being thin or small.

fine.definitionKo: 알곡이나 과일, 모래 등의 둥근 물건이나 글씨의 크기가 작다.
fine.englishDescription: A round object such as a grain, fruit, a grain of sand, etc., or the size of a character being small.
Weather being clear with a clear sky.
Very thin.
The weather being clear and warm and the wind being gentle.

forfeit.definitionKo: 죄를 지은 사람에게서 범죄 행위에 제공하거나 범죄 행위의 결과로 얻은 재산을 강제로 빼앗다.
forfeit.englishDescription: To take forcibly the property of a criminal that was used to help commit the crime or acquired as a result of it.

forfeit.definitionKo: 남의 재물이나 권리, 자격 등을 강제로 빼앗음.
forfeit.englishDescription: The act of taking another person's property, right, qualification, etc., away with force.

forfeit.definitionKo: 남의 재물이나 권리, 자격 등을 강제로 빼앗다.
forfeit.englishDescription: To take another person's property, right, qualification, etc., away with force.
To have one's fame or honor tarnished or lost.

forfeit.definitionKo: 계약을 어기는 사람이 계약의 상대방에게 주기로 약속한 돈.
forfeit.englishExpression: cancellation charge; penalty for breach of contract; forfeit
forfeit.englishDescription: Money that a person who breaks a contract is supposed to give to the other party.

hurdles.englishDescription: An athletic sport in which participants compete by jumping a series of barriers.

laud.englishDescription: To speak highly of someone or praise something.

match.definitionKo: 누가 더 힘이 센지, 누가 더 뛰어난지 드러나도록 싸우다.
match.englishDescription: To engage in a match to decide who is stronger or better.

match.definitionKo: 서로 맞서서 승부를 겨룸.
match.englishDescription: A state in which two sides stand against each other, each attempting to win.

match.definitionKo: 상대에게 맞서 싸움.
match.englishDescription: An act of fighting against one's opponent.

match.definitionKo: 상대에게 맞서 싸우다.
match.englishDescription: To fight against one's opponent.

match.definitionKo: 서로 맞서서 싸우거나 승부를 겨룸.
match.englishDescription: An act of confronting or fighting against each other, or competing for victory.

match.definitionKo: 뒤떨어진 상태에서 같은 수준을 이루다.
match.englishDescription: To reach the same level from the previous state of falling behind.

match.definitionKo: 어떤 것에 잘 맞거나 어울리다.
match.englishDescription: To fit or harmonize with something well.

match.definitionKo: 시합이나 경기.
match.englishDescription: A game or competition.

match.definitionKo: 서로 조화를 이루어 잘 어울리게 하다.
match.englishDescription: To make something be harmonized and go well with another.

match.definitionKo: 힘, 재주, 기량 등이 서로 비슷하여 우열을 가리기 어려운 상대.
match.englishDescription: A counterpart equally good who has a similar level of strength, skill, ability, etc.

match.definitionKo: 서로 떨어져 있는 부분을 제자리에 맞게 대어 붙임.
match.englishDescription: The act of putting together things that are apart from each other.

match.definitionKo: 힘, 지위, 수준 등에서 상대와 거의 같게 되다.
match.englishDescription: For power, a position, level, etc., to become almost the same as that of the other person.

match.definitionKo: 운동이나 기술 등의 능력을 서로 겨룸.
match.englishDescription: Sports or skill-based competitions.

match.definitionKo: 어떤 정도나 수준에 비슷하게 이르다.
match.englishDescription: To reach a similar degree or level.

match.definitionKo: 작은 나뭇개비의 한쪽 끝에 유황 등의 물질을 입혀 까끌까끌한 데에 문질러서 불을 일으키는 도구.
match.englishDescription: A tool that starts a fire by coating one end of a small stick with a substance such as sulfur and rubbing it on a scratchy surface.

match.definitionKo: 보다 높은 수준의 것과 같은 수준에 이르다.
match.englishDescription: To reach the same level as an advanced one.

match.definitionKo: 일이나 물건 등이 꼭 알맞은 것.
match.englishDescription: A task or thing's being perfectly suitable for someone.

match.definitionKo: 앞서 있는 것의 정도나 수준에 가까워지다.
match.englishDescription: To be near the degree or level of someone or something ahead.

match.definitionKo: 일정한 수나 양이 되게 하다.
match.englishDescription: To make the number or quantity of something become specific.

match.definitionKo: 경기나 전투에서 서로 맞붙어 싸움. 또는 그런 경기나 전투.
match.englishDescription: The act of facing and fighting against each other in a match or battle, or such a match or battle.

match.definitionKo: 함께 어울려 한 쌍이나 한 벌을 이루다.
match.englishDescription: To form a pair or set together.

match.definitionKo: 재주나 힘이 서로 비슷해서 맞서 겨룰 만한 상대.
match.englishDescription: Either of the opponents that can put up a good fight against each other since they are similar in talent or power.

match.definitionKo: 힘이나 능력이 비슷하여 서로 견줄 만하다.
match.englishExpression: match; rival; be comparable; be equal
match.englishDescription: For two sides to be comparable because their power and ability are nearly the same.

match.definitionKo: 서로 조화가 되어 잘 어울리다.
match.englishDescription: To be harmonized and go well with another.

material.definitionKo: '옷이나 이불을 만드는 재료'의 뜻을 나타내는 말.
material.englishDescription: A word indicating that something is 'material used for making clothing or bedclothes'.

material.definitionKo: 어떤 일의 대상이 되는 도구, 사물, 사람, 재료를 나타내는 말.
material.englishDescription: A word that is usually used with another noun to mean that a tool, thing, person, or material becomes the object of ridicule,  material for making fire, etc.

material.definitionKo: 인간의 정신과 반대되는 개념으로 객관적으로 존재하는 실체.
material.englishDescription: A substance that exists objectively, which is an idea opposite to the human mind.

material.definitionKo: 공간의 일부를 차지하고 질량을 갖는 요소.
material.englishDescription: An element that occupies part of space and has mass.

material.definitionKo: 광물, 수산물 등과 같이 사람이 생활하거나 경제적인 생산을 하는 데 이용되는 원료.
material.englishDescription: Raw materials such as minerals, fishery resources, etc., which are used by people to live or perform economic production activities.

material.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 만드는 데 바탕이 되는 재료.
material.englishDescription: A material that serves as a basis for making something.
Background materials that constitute the content of a text.

material.definitionKo: 연구나 조사를 하는 데 기본이 되는 재료.
material.englishDescription: Material which is the basis for conducting study or research.
Something that is used to produce an item.

material.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하는 데 쓰이는 거리.
material.englishDescription: A resource used in executing something.

material.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 만들 때 필요한 기본적인 물건이나 재료.
material.englishDescription: A basic object or thing needed for making something.

material.definitionKo: 예술 작품이나 학문 연구의 바탕이 되는 재료.
material.englishDescription: Materials that serve as a basis for an artwork or academic research.

subway.definitionKo: 전기의 힘으로 철길 위를 달리며 한 번에 많은 사람을 태울 수 있는 긴 차.
subway.englishDescription: A long, electrically-powered vehicle that runs on tracks and is capable of carrying a large number of passengers.
An electric vehicle operating on an underground railway.
An underground railway installed by digging a tunnel.

tension.definitionKo: 마음을 놓지 못하고 정신을 바짝 차리게 되는 느낌.
tension.englishDescription: The feeling that causes one not to relax, but to concentate.

tension.definitionKo: 마음을 놓지 못하고 정신을 바짝 차리고 있는 느낌.
tension.englishDescription: A feeling of alertness, not being relaxed.

tension.definitionKo: 마음을 놓지 않고 정신을 바짝 차림.
tension.englishDescription: The act of being alert without being able to relax.

tension.definitionKo: 서로의 관계가 평온하지 않고 다툼이 일어날 것 같은 상황이나 분위기.
tension.englishDescription: A situation or atmosphere in which two parties are not comfortable in their relationship and are likely to have fight.

tension.definitionKo: 몸의 근육이나 신경이 계속 움츠러들거나 흥분하는 상태.
tension.englishDescription: A state in which muscles or nerves continue to contract or get excited.
The strength to leap or maintain the tension like a spring.

tension.definitionKo: 탄성이 있는 물체가 본래의 형태로 돌아가려는 힘.
tension.englishDescription: The force of an object with tension to go back to its original shape.

trot.definitionKo: 발을 가까이 자주 떼면서 급히 걷는 걸음.
trot.englishDescription: A quick gait in which a person takes steps frequently with his/her feet moving close to each other.

understatement.definitionKo: 실제보다 더 보태거나 깎아서 말하는 일.
understatement.englishDescription: The act of overstating or understating something.
